name: Hank 4
source:
If you're hankering for a harem of high-flyin' handsome hunks, then look no further than the Hanks. Sure, they're all different hangers individually, but they share the same passion for adventure and adrenaline that keeps them all moving forward to the next jump zone. You'd never dream of breaking up this polyamorous playdate, and if you're lucky you just might end up in the center of their attention... Well, at least until the next epic low-pressure zone comes in. Sponsored by Red Bowl.
Likes: Thermals, Waves, The Majestic Dance between Gravity, Death, and Freedom 
Dislikes: Reading

[From the in-game Date-A-Dex]
